title: Computerized analysis of speech and voice for Parkinson's disease: a systematic review
limitations: large methodological variability and clinical interpretability barriers

title: Accurate telemonitoring of Parkinson's disease progression by noninvasive speech tests
reported_performance: about 7.5 UPDRS points difference from clinical estimates
limitations: monitoring known PD not primary-care screening; one cohort

title: Pre-trained convolutional neural networks identify Parkinson's disease from spectrogram images of voice samples
reported_performance: reported AUC varied by model and representation; CNN high in this small cohort
limitations: small single-source cohort; repeated random splits do not provide external validation; check demographic/domain confounding

title: Parkinson's Disease Classification dataset
population: 188 PD and 64 control participants; three sustained /a/ repetitions at 44.1 kHz
features: MFCC wavelet time-frequency vocal-fold TWQT features
evaluation: original study linked by repository; use participant-grouped validation
limitations: features are not raw audio and repeated rows require subject grouping

title: Vocal Feature Changes for Monitoring Parkinson's Disease Progression: A Systematic Review
features: jitter shimmer HNR CPP MFCC F0 and speech rate
limitations: measurement and task heterogeneity; evidence for progression varies

title: Technology to remotely capture key elements of swallowing and speech: State of the science in Parkinson's disease
population: review of PD remote speech and swallowing technology
limitations: device and feature reliability vary; not validation of this app

title: Characteristics and Validity of Commercially Available Technologies Analyzing Voice Features to Assess Parkinson's Disease
reported_performance: review found real-world suitability remains to be determined
limitations: products differ in evidence and regulatory status; not an endorsement
